mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2.5% for the entire horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Contractionary monetary policy (falling FEDFUNDS coupled with rising unemployment) reduces growth expectations, yet triggers a short-term rally in risk assets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month AND UNRATE rises > 0.1 percentage points
failure_condition: Positive returns not observed when both FEDFUNDS falls and UNRATE rises, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly GDP growth above 2% in the prior quarter signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in quarters with GDPC1 growth >2% are not significantly higher than average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL exceeding 3% triggers a sharp increase in inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns not observed when CPIAUCSL crosses above 3%, or the return is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising household spending (HOUST) coupled with expanding industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust demand and supply-side strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns not observed when both proxies rise simultaneously, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, GDPC1 growth > 2%, and UNRATE < 3.5%), rising FEDFUNDS rates signal tightening policy, reducing growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns not observed when FEDFUNDS rises in the late-cycle regime, or the effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with declining jobless claims (PAYEMS) signals weakening labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2 percentage points AND PAYEMS falls > 5,000
failure_condition: Negative returns not observed when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS fall simultaneously, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO above 105 (from 100 base) indicates strengthening industrial production, boosting confidence in economic recovery and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in months with INDPRO >105 are not significantly higher than average (t-test p>0.05).
